## Current Commercial Positioning

Igor Ganapolsky sells fixed-scope Stripe Connect / marketplace payments / refunds / webhooks / tax-boundary work, plus OpenClaw/Codex/Claude Computer Use safety diagnostics and ResumeOS resume-risk audits.

Do not treat generic AI/RAG as the primary paid wedge. Do not describe speculative proposals or viewed proposals as revenue. Public evidence as of 2026-06-06 includes one verified paid Upwork client and $1,350 realized Upwork cash recorded in the operating ledger.
